# Semver carve-out fixture

This fixture contains version strings that look like `vN` tokens but
are software release references and must NOT be flagged.

Pydantic v2.1.0 ships breaking changes versus v1.10.x.
eggNOG-mapper v2.1.13 is the version used in the evaluation.
The contracts package is pinned at v0.3.0.
Alembic v1.13.2 handles schema migrations.
